title: Mojiang purple rice (ZN65) T2T genome — analysis code
description: Analysis pipeline and figure-generation code accompanying the manuscript "A gap-free telomere-to-telomere genome of the purple-pericarp rice landrace Mojiang ZN65 resolves transposon-associated structural variation at the pericarp-pigmentation loci" (Oryza sativa ZN65). Includes the upstream analysis pipeline (assembly QC, genome-wide structural-variation calling, centromere/rDNA characterisation, transposable-element attribution, flavonoid-pathway copy number, functional-allele status, LTR-retrotransposon dating, phylogenetics, 3K-RGP subspecies placement, RNA-seq re-mapping), plus the small derived tables. No genome assembly, annotation, or raw sequencing reads are included.
